item: DuckDB never spills plaintext into the working directory
summary: Open-on-main row 24, measured on DuckDB 1.4.0 and 2.0.0: an in-memory store opened with no offload folder (map_serve, the source-coverage benchmark) spilled rows in plaintext into ./.tmp in the working directory whatever the corpus encryption; the persisted encrypted store spilled its temporary catalog (TEMP TABLE _new_meta, intermediates) in plaintext the same way. No folder now means no offload, and the persisted config turns temp_file_encryption on.
